standard.summary: 开启增强防护模式时，训练器会在多个层面加强稳定性保护：更频繁的梯度检查、自动 LR 回退、内存压力监控等。swap_count/ratio 控制相关的交换操作参数。
standard.effect: 开启后训练更稳定但速度可能略慢（约 5~10%）。适合不稳定的训练环境（高 LR、小数据集、不稳定架构）。
standard.whenToUse: 遇到频繁 NaN/Inf 或训练不稳定时作为综合保护措施。
standard.avoidWhen: 稳定训练环境无需开启，避免额外开销。

standard_en.summary: With enhanced protection on, the trainer strengthens stability safeguards on several fronts: more frequent gradient checks, automatic LR rollback, memory pressure monitoring and so on. swap_count/ratio control the related swap parameters.
standard_en.effect: Training is steadier but may be around 5-10% slower. It suits unstable settings -- a high LR, a small dataset, an unstable architecture.
standard_en.whenToUse: As an all-round safeguard when you hit frequent NaN/Inf or unstable training.
standard_en.avoidWhen: A stable environment does not need it; leaving it off avoids the overhead.
